value.rationale: Replace the mixed neural/raw merger with a clause-frame compiler that derives permissions, outsider prohibitions, inherited list items, disposal frames, and post-disposal retention only from the current source. Each frame uses one producing clause-group query on every component, preventing evidence-window Cartesian joins. Survival-only language is excluded from retention permission, and actor-side Representatives are not misread as recipients.
source_functions:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    queries = []
    answers = []
    fragments = []
    unresolved = []
    legal_raw(inputs, queries, answers, fragments, unresolved)
    return {'queries': queries, 'answers': answers, 'fragments': fragments, 'unresolved': unresolved}

def acq_emit_permission(queries, answers, fragments, unit, supports, text, recipient):
    if recipient is None:
        return
    identity = 'program:clause-frame:permission:' + str(unit)
    legal_add_query(queries, answers, identity, 'source_clause_kind', supports, 'source_permission')
    legal_add_fragment(fragments, ['disclose', ['confidential_information'], recipient], supports, [identity])
    legal_add_fragment(fragments, acq_condition_term(text), supports, [identity])

def legal_raw(inputs, queries, answers, fragments, unresolved):
    spans = []
    for span in inputs.get('source_spans', []):
        if isinstance(span, dict) and type(span.get('id')) is int and isinstance(span.get('text'), str):
            spans.append(span)
    permission_governor = ''
    permission_governor_ids = []
    permission_governor_index = -10
    disposal_governor = ''
    disposal_governor_ids = []
    disposal_governor_index = -10
    recent_disposal = []
    recent_disposal_index = -10
    i = 0
    while i < len(spans):
        span = spans[i]
        unit = span.get('id')
        text = span.get('text')
        low = text.lower()
        if i - permission_governor_index > 4:
            permission_governor = ''
            permission_governor_ids = []
        if i - disposal_governor_index > 5:
            disposal_governor = ''
            disposal_governor_ids = []
        if i - recent_disposal_index > 8:
            recent_disposal = []
        inherited_permission = bool(permission_governor_ids) and bool(re.match('^\\s*(?:\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)+|\\([a-z0-9]+\\)|[a-z0-9]+\\))', text))
        permission_text = (permission_governor + ' ' + text).strip() if inherited_permission else text
        permission_support = list(permission_governor_ids) + [unit] if inherited_permission else [unit]
        permission_low = permission_text.lower()
        embedded_marker = any(marker in low for marker in ('except in confidence to', 'except only to', 'except its ', 'except their ', 'except such '))
        roles = acq_role_terms(permission_text, spans)
        direct_permission = any(token in permission_low for token in ('may disclose', 'may share', 'will disclose', 'shall restrict access', 'restrict access to', 'restrict disclosure', 'access to confidential information by the receiving party shall be limited', 'may be disclosed only', 'reveal the information only to', 'disclose information it receives')) or embedded_marker
        false_permission = any(token in low for token in ('signed the mandatory non-disclosure agreement', 'hosted or taken outside', 'send auditee', 'not to engage or appoint any non-resident', 'right to disclose confidential information to receiving party'))
        if direct_permission and not false_permission and roles[0] is not None:
            supports = list(permission_support)
            for extra in roles[1]:
                if extra not in supports:
                    supports.append(extra)
            acq_emit_permission(queries, answers, fragments, unit, supports, permission_text, roles[0])
        if any(token in low for token in ('may disclose confidential information:', 'may disclose the confidential information to:', 'may disclose the confidential information:')) and roles[0] is None:
            permission_governor = text
            permission_governor_ids = [unit]
            permission_governor_index = i
        explicit_ban = any(token in low for token in ('shall not disclose', 'agrees not to disclose', 'not to disclose', 'prohibited from disclosing', 'will not disclose', 'not disclose said information', 'neither party shall disclose', 'neither it nor its representatives')) and any(token in low for token in ('third party', 'third parties', 'any other person', 'anyone', 'any person or entity', 'except its ', 'except their ', 'except in confidence to'))
        if explicit_ban:
            permitted = roles[0] if embedded_marker else None
            acq_emit_prohibition(queries, answers, fragments, unit, [unit], text, permitted)
        heading_disposal = ('shall:' in low or low.rstrip().endswith('shall')) and not any(token in low for token in ('return all', 'return the confidential', 'destroy all', 'delete all', 'erase all'))
        heading_disposal = heading_disposal or ('return of confidential information' in low and 'shall' in low)
        if heading_disposal:
            disposal_governor = text
            disposal_governor_ids = [unit]
            disposal_governor_index = i
        inherited_disposal = bool(disposal_governor_ids) and bool(re.match('^\\s*(?:\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)+|\\([a-z0-9]+\\)|[a-z0-9]+\\))', text))
        disposal_text = (disposal_governor + ' ' + text).strip() if inherited_disposal else text
        disposal_support = list(disposal_governor_ids) + [unit] if inherited_disposal else [unit]
        disposal_low = disposal_text.lower()
        has_action = any(token in disposal_low for token in ('return', 'destroy', 'delete', 'erase'))
        operative = has_action and (inherited_disposal or any(token in disposal_low for token in ('shall return', 'shall promptly return', 'shall destroy', 'shall delete', 'shall erase', 'agrees to return', 'required to return', 'bound to return', 'will promptly return', 'to promptly return')))
        trigger = legal_trigger(disposal_text)
        if operative and trigger is not None and not legal_retention_signal(text):
            material = legal_material(disposal_text)
            action = acq_disposal_action(disposal_text, material)
            if action is not None:
                identity = 'program:clause-frame:disposal:' + str(unit)
                future_ids = []
                future_text = []
                j = i + 1
                while j < len(spans) and j <= i + 4:
                    candidate = spans[j].get('text')
                    if legal_retention_signal(candidate):
                        future_ids.append(spans[j].get('id'))
                        future_text.append(candidate)
                    j += 1
                group_support = list(disposal_support)
                for future in future_ids:
                    if future not in group_support:
                        group_support.append(future)
                legal_add_query(queries, answers, identity, 'source_clause_kind', group_support, 'source_other')
                legal_add_fragment(fragments, action, disposal_support, [identity])
                legal_add_fragment(fragments, trigger, disposal_support, [identity])
                if future_ids:
                    wording = ' '.join(future_text)
                    info = ['copies_of', ['confidential_information']] if any(token in wording.lower() for token in ('copy', 'copies', 'backup', 'archive')) else ['confidential_information']
                    exception = ['exception_set', ['retention_exception', ['receiving_party'], info, ['retention_condition', wording]]]
                    legal_add_fragment(fragments, exception, group_support, [identity])
                else:
                    legal_add_fragment(fragments, ['no_exceptions'], disposal_support, [identity])
                recent_disposal = list(disposal_support)
                recent_disposal_index = i
        if legal_retention_signal(text):
            identity = 'program:clause-frame:retention:' + str(unit)
            if recent_disposal:
                support = list(recent_disposal)
                if unit not in support:
                    support.append(unit)
                legal_add_query(queries, answers, identity, 'source_retention_scope', support, 'post_disposal_retention_permission')
                info = ['copies_of', ['confidential_information']] if any(token in low for token in ('copy', 'copies', 'backup', 'archive')) else ['confidential_information']
                legal_add_fragment(fragments, info, support, [identity])
                legal_add_fragment(fragments, ['after_disposal'], support, [identity])
                legal_add_fragment(fragments, ['retention_condition', text], support, [identity])
            else:
                legal_add_query(queries, answers, identity, 'source_retention_scope', [unit], 'ordinary_use_retention')
        survival = 'continue to apply to such retained confidential information' in low or ('continue to be bound' in low and any(token in low for token in ('return', 'completion of the purpose', 'documents and materials'))) or ('duties of confidentiality' in low and 'survive' in low)
        if survival:
            identity = 'program:clause-frame:survival:' + str(unit)
            legal_add_query(queries, answers, identity, 'source_retention_scope', [unit], 'confidentiality_survival_only')
        i += 1
